reason: I would probably try the free plan like every other AI tool I find, but I keep about one in ten and I already have a chat widget. I have no proof yet that a mascot would lift my sign-ups rather than just look cute.
objection: A cartoon mascot could look childish or unprofessional for my brand, and a bot that talks to visitors who may be kids raises child-privacy questions that a GDPR data agreement does not settle. I also have not seen a real lift number from a site like mine.
would_change_my_mind: A case study from a comparable consumer or edtech app showing a measured sign-up lift, plus the sober pro look working on my own site during the free trial.
